title: Authoring-time judge obligation for cells that touch guard source
action: Close the gap named by docs/knowledge/patterns/20260812-a-guard-and-its-tests-are-one-model-*.md and its backlog row: a cell that changes GUARD source at lane tiny or small never meets the judge-debt close door (close.rs pushes it only for standard/high-risk), so the change that most needs an independent read is the one that escapes it. Add a JUDGE OBLIGATION beside the existing REGEN_OBLIGATION in obligation.rs, same shape and same voice: cells add refuses a cell whose declared files touch a judge-required root UNLESS the cell lane is standard or high-risk (where the door already applies) or the cell carries judge_obligation_ack with a one-line reason (recorded on the cell, so skipping is a named act). The refusal names the offending file, why the rule exists in one clause, and BOTH escapes. Judge-required roots must not be a hand-kept list that rots — follow the REGEN_GUARDS discipline documented at obligation.rs:50-72 (the guard reads the same constant the authority uses, pinned in both directions by tests). Here the authority is the source tree: declare the roots as a constant (the hooks module dir plus any directory whose path carries a guard segment), and pin it BOTH ways — every declared root exists on disk, and every path under the crate src whose segment contains guard is covered by a declared root, so a new guard module outside the roots turns a test red. Sync the authoring spec (cells-authoring-and-revision.md) with the new obligation beside the regen one.

truths: A tiny or small cell touching guard source is refused at authoring with both escapes named
A standard or high-risk cell touching guard source is accepted (the close door covers it)
judge_obligation_ack is recorded on the cell so the skip is auditable
A new guard directory outside the declared roots turns a test red
Cells touching no guard source are unaffected

trace.outcome: Added authoring-time JUDGE_OBLIGATION beside REGEN_OBLIGATION in obligation.rs: cells add refuses a cell whose files touch a judge-required guard root at lane tiny/small/spike/docs, unless the cell's lane is standard/high-risk (already covered by close.rs's judge-debt door) or it carries judge_obligation_ack with a one-line reason. Judge-required roots (JUDGE_REQUIRED_ROOTS) are pinned both ways against the crate source tree by two tests, proved red by temporarily adding a fake guard dir outside the roots then green again after removing it. Synced the authoring spec (B52/R103 + pointer). Not wired into validate_new_cell (validate.rs) since that file is outside this cell's declared files; that one-line follow-up call remains open.
deviations: The 'reservations reserve' CLI call hit the documented known cross-worktree-hold defect (self-referential hold naming this same cell/session); per contract did not retry, and proceeded using the reservation leases already granted at claim time.
